about_the_game:
Aetherfall is a stylized third-person action RPG extraction shooter set in an elemental apocalypse where the remnants of humanity fight for survival. Awaken from stasis and step into a world mutated by primal elemental forces, where every expedition is a high-stakes gamble. Master martial-arts inspired elemental combat, outwit rival factions and mutated beasts, uncover hidden secrets, and secure powerful loot—but beware: dying in the field means losing everything you carry.

Martial Arts & Elemental Combat

Unleash powerful combos by blending martial arts with elemental magic. Mix elements to create devastating effects and shape the flow of battle.

Deep Progression & Customization

Shape your playstyle with a fully customizable character build. Focus on a tanky Earth build, a fast-moving Fire build that burns enemies down while kiting, or anything in between. With 9 unique elements to mix and match, the possibilities are endless.

Elemental Fields System

Shape the battlefield with elemental fields born from your attacks. Interact with them in real-time to unleash combos, dashes, and massive explosions.

Elemental Enemies

The creatures of the old world have been warped by the Aetherfall—ordinary animals twisted into fierce elemental predators. Each elemental mutation has unique strengths, requiring strategic adaptation and cunning to defeat. Local survivors have coined names for these formidable foes:

  • Blazeclaws – Bears fueled by volcanic rage, leaving fiery destruction in their wake.

  • Dustwraiths – Snake ambush predators lurking beneath the sand, striking from sudden, blinding whirlwinds.

  • Tideboars – Ferocious boars empowered by the seas, crashing through foes on waves summoned at will.

  • Earthweavers – Giant spiders of rock and soil, laying stone webs and springing from beneath the ground.

Survive encounters with these and countless other warped beasts, mastering elemental strategies to overcome their deadly abilities.

Explore a Ruined World

Venture into a shattered world shaped by elemental chaos. Use your powers to solve environmental puzzles, uncover hidden paths, unlock ambush routes, and create escape shortcuts. Every corner of the world holds secrets for those willing to look—and fight—for them.

Dynamic PvPvE Combat

In Aetherfall, danger comes from all sides—enemy players, mutated beasts, and the world itself.

Stalk weakened rivals after a tough boss fight, clash head-on in fair duels, or play it safe on the outskirts. The choice is yours.

With match lengths ranging from quick 15-minute runs to hour-long marathons, every expedition is shaped by your strategy, risk appetite, and survival instincts.

If Aetherfall sounds interesting and you want to stay up to date on news, please add to your wishlist !

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4430 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 2GB / AMD Radeon R7 370 2GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 3GB / AMD Radeon RX 580 4GB
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
